answer: Tournament bond: one identity, knockout bracket; only winners share the reward. Entry docks 70 credits at the wharf and is listed on the meadow board. Each round the lantern beacon pairs contestants for a task; losers leave. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 × 70 = 70,000 for a fixed 40,000-credit pool, and mostly eliminate each other, so it loses money. A bracket-stuffing ring is caught when cluster entries meet in round one. An honest agent pays 70 once.
